Bring the Steel

Schools, homeschool groups, festivals, markets, birthdays, community organizations and event hosts can bring the Reavers beyond the training hall.

What we can do

More than a fight in armour

Armoured combat gets attention, and a good Reavers appearance gives people context too: demonstrations, equipment, sport education, questions, photos and audience interaction, shaped to fit your group and space.

I

Live demonstration

Armoured combat

Controlled live combat with an explanation of the rules, equipment, safety, tactics and what the audience is watching.

II

Learn

Armour & sport education

See modern buhurt equipment up close, learn how it is used, and hear how the sport connects historical inspiration with modern competition.

III

Meet the team

Questions & photos

A relaxed option for groups who want to meet fighters, ask questions, see armour and take photos without a full combat demonstration.

IV

Build your format

Mix what fits

Most appearances combine pieces of the options above. We confirm what works once we know the venue, audience, timing and team availability.

Good fit for

Community looks different everywhere

You do not need to know exactly what to ask for. Tell us what you are planning and who will be there, and we will work out the right format with you.

SchoolsClass visits, history connections, sport education and activity days.
Homeschool groupsInteractive learning sessions, armour, questions and demonstrations.
Festivals & fairsPublic demonstrations, scheduled appearances and crowd-friendly explanations.
Markets & community daysMeet the team, armour displays, recruitment, photos and short demos where suitable.
Birthdays & private groupsA memorable introduction to real armoured combat, built around the age group and space.
Local partnersSponsorship, event partnerships, venues, fundraising and community collaboration.

How it works

Start simple

An inquiry does not lock either side into a booking. It gives us enough to check the team, venue, safety needs, travel and the format that makes sense.

I

Tell us about it

Share the date if you have one, the location, the audience and the kind of event or group.

II

We shape the idea

We look at team availability and what kind of appearance fits the space and audience.

III

Confirm the details

Timing, setup, safety boundaries, travel, expectations and any costs or donations, agreed before the day.

Book · Partner · Ask

Tell us what you are thinking

You do not need a finished plan. Send the basics and the Reavers will work out whether we are a fit.
